  # === Category 1: Reward Diversity / Reward Shaping for RL Stability ===

  - title: "GDPO: Group reward-Decoupled Normalization Policy Optimization for Multi-reward RL Optimization"
    authors: NVIDIA Labs
    year: 2025
    venue: ICML 2026
    url: https://arxiv.org/abs/2601.05242
    category: reward_diversity
    role: closest_prior_work
    key_finding: >
      直接将 GRPO 应用于多 reward 组合时，不同 rollout 的 reward 组合在归一化后 collapse 为相同 advantage 值，
      降低训练信号分辨率导致收敛失败。GDPO 对每个 reward 独立做 group-wise normalization 再聚合，
      保留多 reward 的相对差异，显著提升训练稳定性。
    relevance_to_ced_stabilizer: >
      最直接相关。CED reward 本质上引入了独立于 extraction F1 的 reward 维度（evidence quality），
      GDPO 的理论分析解释了为什么多维 reward 比单一 reward 更稳定——独立 reward 维度防止 advantage collapse。
      但 GDPO 是方法论贡献，CED 是 task-specific reward 设计自然具备了这一特性。

  - title: "DRA-GRPO: Exploring Diversity-Aware Reward Adjustment for R1-Zero-Like Training of LLMs"
    authors: Xiwen Chen et al.
    year: 2025
    venue: arXiv 2505.09655
    url: https://arxiv.org/abs/2505.09655
    category: reward_diversity
    role: related_method
    key_finding: >
      GRPO 的标量 reward 无法区分语义多样但得分相同的输出（diversity-quality inconsistency）。
      DRA 用子模互信息（SMI）对 reward 加权，给多样性高的 completion 更大权重，
      等价于 Inverse Propensity Scoring 去偏，防止 policy 坍缩到先验模式。
    relevance_to_ced_stabilizer: >
      DRA 通过后处理 reward 注入多样性信号；CED 的 reward 本身就内含对比结构自然提供 diversity 信号。
      机制互补但来源不同——CED 是 reward design 层面，DRA 是 optimization 层面。

  - title: "Shrinking the Variance: Shrinkage Baselines for RL with Verifiable Rewards"
    authors: Guanning Zeng et al.
    year: 2025
    venue: arXiv 2511.03710
    url: https://arxiv.org/abs/2511.03710
    category: reward_diversity
    role: theoretical_support
    key_finding: >
      RLVR 中 per-prompt 均值 baseline 在低 generation 数下估计不准导致高 variance 梯度。
      用 James-Stein shrinkage 混合 per-prompt 和 cross-prompt 均值，
      构造可证明更低 variance 的 policy gradient estimator。
    relevance_to_ced_stabilizer: >
      理论支持：reward variance 对 gradient estimation 质量至关重要。
      CED 的额外 reward 维度提供更丰富的 per-group variance，间接起到 variance 维持效果。

  - title: "Reward Shaping to Mitigate Reward Hacking in RLHF"
    authors: Anonymous
    year: 2025
    venue: arXiv 2502.18770
    url: https://arxiv.org/abs/2502.18770
    category: reward_diversity
    role: background
    key_finding: >
      RL reward 应有界且先快速增长后缓慢收敛。系统研究 reward shaping 原则，
      好的 reward 形状能抑制 reward hacking 并提升训练稳定性。
    relevance_to_ced_stabilizer: >
      CED reward 的 0-1 对比判别结构天然满足有界性，
      且 evidence quality 的渐进提升符合"先快后慢"的 reward shaping 原则。

  # === Category 2: Mode Collapse Prevention in GRPO/RLHF ===

  - title: "DAPO: An Open-Source LLM Reinforcement Learning System at Scale"
    authors: ByteDance Seed, Tsinghua AIR
    year: 2025
    venue: NeurIPS 2025
    url: https://arxiv.org/abs/2503.14476
    category: mode_collapse_prevention
    role: key_baseline
    key_finding: >
      Naive GRPO 存在 entropy collapse（policy 熵快速下降→输出同质化）。
      根因：clipping 不对称性——概率 0.01 的 token 最多增到 0.012，而概率 0.9 的 token 可达 1.08，
      低概率 token 难以增长，抑制探索。DAPO 提出 Clip-Higher（εhigh=0.28 > εlow=0.2）
      为低概率 token 留更大增长空间，加 Dynamic Sampling 过滤 accuracy=0 或 1 的 prompt
      （这些 prompt 产生零梯度，降低有效 batch size）。在 AIME 2024 达 50 分超越 DeepSeek-R1-Zero。
    relevance_to_ced_stabilizer: >
      DAPO 从 optimization 技巧角度解决 entropy collapse。CED reward 从 reward design 层面
      防止 mode collapse——evidence quality 维度确保 reward 组内有足够 variance，
      不会出现 all-same-reward 的零梯度 prompt。DAPO 的 Dynamic Sampling 过滤 accuracy=0/1 prompt
      与我们观察到的 frac_zero_std→0.8 现象本质相同：extraction-only reward 下大量 prompt
      产生零 advantage，CED 从源头（reward 设计）而非后处理（过滤）解决这个问题。

  - title: "Dr. GRPO: Removing Optimization Bias in GRPO"
    authors: Liu et al.
    year: 2025
    venue: COLM 2025
    url: https://arxiv.org/abs/2503.20783
    category: mode_collapse_prevention
    role: related_analysis
    key_finding: >
      GRPO 的 std 归一化引入两个 bias：(1) difficulty bias——std(r) 归一化对低 variance 组
      （全对/全错）给予过高 advantage 权重，trivial question 主导训练信号；
      (2) length bias——per-token loss 的 1/|o_i| 项使长的错误回答被 under-penalize。
      当 std(r)→0 时 advantage 爆炸或未定义，梯度数值不稳定。
      Dr. GRPO 移除 std 归一化，用无偏 Monte Carlo advantage：Ã = R(q,o_i) - mean(R)。

    venue: NeurIPS 2025
    url: https://arxiv.org/abs/2504.19599

      将 KL 约束 reward 最大化的解析解直接嵌入梯度权重，
      variance 项自然平衡 exploration 与 exploitation，维持适度 entropy。
    relevance_to_ced_stabilizer: >
      GVPO 的 variance 项机制与 CED 维持 reward variance 的效果功能类似，
      但 GVPO 是算法层面 implicit regularization，CED 是 reward 层面 explicit structure。

    authors: Jian Hu et al.
    year: 2025
    venue: arXiv 2501.03262
    url: https://arxiv.org/abs/2501.03262
    category: mode_collapse_prevention
    role: related_method
    key_finding: >
      Prompt-level (local) advantage normalization 导致不准确估计和过拟合。

- Primary: **EMNLP 2026 Main** (ARR July cycle, ~July 15-25 → commit EMNLP Aug/Sep)

## Core Insight

LLM-based document-level IE 已逼近 encoder SOTA 的抽取精度，但零方法能生成可验证证据。本文提出 **evidence-grounded DocRE** 作为新任务范式：LLM 同时输出关系三元组和支撑证据句。

我们系统性地探索了 online RL (GRPO) 、offline preference optimization (DPO) 和 offline RL (RSFT) 三条技术路线。关键发现：**RL optimization pressure 与 evidence-extraction decoupling severity 正相关**——优化强度越大，evidence 质量提升的同时抽取能力退化越严重。QLoRA 放大至 catastrophic（rel_f1<0.02），bf16 GRPO 从 0.4549 退化至 ~0.434（mild, -2pp），DPO 呈 gradual 退化（1ep→3ep rel_f1 从 0.4034→0.3429），RSFT 无 decoupling。

CED (Contrastive Evidence Discrimination) 是一种 NLI-based 候选筛选函数，通过文档内 hard negative 对比评估 evidence 质量。CED 作为 RSFT 的 scoring function 之一进行测试，其相对于 flat-NLI 的优势需要通过充分的统计检验验证。

5. **Key finding**: evidence-extraction decoupling — RL optimization pressure 与 decoupling severity 正相关，形成连续谱系（GRPO-QLoRA catastrophic > GRPO-bf16 mild > DPO gradual > RSFT none）
6. **QLoRA amplification**: QLoRA 量化将 mild decoupling 放大至 catastrophic forgetting——decoupling 是 RL-for-IE 的通用梯度，QLoRA 是 catastrophic amplifier
7. **What works**: RSFT with NLI-based scoring 是唯一有效路线——提升 evidence 质量而不牺牲抽取
8. **Best practical solution**: CED reranker 恢复 97% 的 evidence 代价，同时保留高质量 evidence（evi_f1=0.8188）

\section{Related Work}

\subsection{Document-Level Relation Extraction}

Document-level relation extraction (DocRE) requires identifying relations between entity pairs scattered across multiple sentences, demanding cross-sentence reasoning over long contexts. Encoder-based methods have established strong baselines: DREEAM \cite{ma2023dreeam} guides attention with evidence supervision and self-training, while EIDER \cite{xie2022eider} fuses predictions from extracted evidence and the full document at inference time. CDER \cite{tran2025cder} captures collaborative patterns among semantically similar entity pairs via bipartite graphs, and EAAGRE \cite{eaagre2024} guides attention to evidence sentences without extra trainable parameters. These encoder methods, however, are limited to predefined relation schemas and cannot generalize to open-domain settings.

Recent work has turned to LLMs for DocRE. AutoRE \cite{autore2024} introduces a Relation-Head-Facts paradigm using Mistral-7B with QLoRA. RelPrior \cite{relprior2025} uses binary relation priors to filter irrelevant entity pairs before matching predefined relations, achieving DocRED test F1 of 48.34 with LLaMA3-8B. LMRC \cite{li2024lmrc} combines a BERT-based classifier for NA filtering with LLM multi-class classification, reaching Re-DocRED F1 of 74.63. DocKS-RAG \cite{xu2025docksrag} integrates document-level knowledge graphs with sentence-level semantic RAG via hybrid-prompt tuning. GLiDRE \cite{glidre2025} trains a lightweight dual-encoder for zero/few-shot DocRE. A comprehensive survey by \citet{generative_ie_survey2024} identifies structured output quality and efficiency as key challenges for LLM-based IE.

While these methods advance extraction accuracy, none jointly produces verifiable evidence sentences alongside relational triples. FREIGE addresses this gap by formulating evidence-grounded DocRE as a unified generation task.

\subsection{Evidence-Based Information Extraction}

Evidence grounding has been explored primarily through encoder architectures in DocRE. DREEAM \cite{ma2023dreeam} pioneered evidence retrieval self-training to generate silver evidence at scale. Evidence-aware DocRE \cite{xu2022evidence_aware} models evidence sentence selection as a sequential decision problem using reinforcement learning. GEGA \cite{mao2024gega} uses GCN with multi-weight matrices to guide attention to evidence sentences via a teacher-student framework. COREX \cite{corex2024} jointly supervises two-hop reasoning and evidence prediction with adaptive focal loss. KnowRA \cite{mai2025knowra} augments DocRE with external knowledge retrieval and coreference-enhanced document knowledge graphs. Beyond DocRE, Grounded KG Extraction \cite{grounded_kg2025} provides character-level provenance tracking for each extracted triple.

In the broader NLP landscape, the tension between faithfulness and task performance is well-documented. \citet{sprague2024mind_your_step} show that chain-of-thought can reduce performance by up to 36.3\% on certain tasks due to error accumulation. \citet{resck2024performance_explanation} formally explore the Pareto frontier between performance and explanation plausibility via multi-objective optimization. \citet{wallat2024correctness_faithfulness} demonstrate that correctness and faithfulness are independent dimensions, with up to 57\% of citations being post-rationalized. \citet{lyu2024faithful_survey} survey faithful explanations in NLP, identifying the faithfulness-performance trade-off as a core challenge. These findings motivate our framing of the ``evidence generation tax''---the cost in extraction accuracy incurred by requiring models to simultaneously produce supporting evidence.

\subsection{Rejection Sampling and Reward-Based Fine-Tuning}

Rejection sampling fine-tuning (RSFT) iteratively generates candidate responses, scores them with a reward function, and fine-tunes on the top-ranked outputs. RAFT \cite{raft2024} establishes the canonical framework: generate $n$ responses per prompt, rank by reward, and train on the top-$k$. \citet{xiao2025minimalist_rsft} show that this simple approach matches GRPO and PPO on mathematical reasoning, with GRPO's advantage stemming mainly from discarding all-wrong prompts rather than reward normalization. The theoretical connection to policy optimization is formalized by \citet{rsft_ppo2025}, who prove RSFT implicitly performs PPO with marginal KL constraints.

Several extensions improve RSFT's sample efficiency. AdaSTaR \cite{chung2025adaptar} introduces diversity and curriculum sampling to address training imbalance, achieving SOTA with 58.6\% fewer FLOPs. TrajFusion \cite{deng2026trajfusion} interleaves failed and correct trajectories to model trial-and-error reasoning. RIFT \cite{rift2026} replaces hard rejection with soft reweighting of all trajectories by scalar reward, providing reverse gradients from negative samples. RS-DPO \cite{rsdpo2024} systematically combines rejection sampling with DPO by identifying contrastive pairs from the reward distribution.

At inference time, Best-of-N (BoN) sampling applies the same generate-and-select principle without further training. \citet{huang2025bon_optimality} prove BoN provably suffers from reward hacking at large $N$ and propose InferenceTimePessimism for scaling-monotonic performance. \citet{chen2025inference_reward_hacking} show that the true reward first rises then falls under all inference-time mechanisms. Genie \cite{yehudai2024genie} demonstrates NLI-based filtering in a three-stage pipeline achieving human parity on content-grounded generation.

FREIGE adopts RSFT with NLI-based scoring (CED) as its primary training strategy, and uses CED as an inference-time reranker---bridging RSFT and BoN paradigms while avoiding the decoupling pathology observed with online RL methods.

\subsection{Reinforcement Learning for Structured Generation}

Group Relative Policy Optimization (GRPO) has emerged as a prominent critic-free RL method for LLMs. DAPO \cite{dapo2025} addresses GRPO's entropy collapse via asymmetric clipping and dynamic sampling. Dr.\ GRPO \cite{dr_grpo2025} identifies difficulty and length biases from standard normalization. REINFORCE++ \cite{hu2025reinforcepp} proposes global batch normalization for more stable gradient estimation. In structured IE, R1-RE \cite{dai2025r1re} applies GRPO with verifiable rewards for cross-domain sentence-level RE, and R2GRPO \cite{li2025r2grpo} combines relevance and rule-mining rewards for scientific IE. E-GRPO \cite{egrpo2025} designs entity-aware rewards giving partial credit based on entity match rate. ReasoningNER \cite{reasoningner2025} uses a three-stage GRPO framework beating GPT-4 on zero-shot NER.

However, applying RL to structured extraction tasks introduces pathologies not observed in reasoning benchmarks. \citet{jin2025rl_vs_sft} show RL fine-tuning cannot fully recover performance when SFT causes severe overfitting. EvidenceRL \cite{bentamo2026evidencerl}, the closest concurrent work to ours, uses GRPO to jointly optimize evidence entailment and correctness in clinical diagnosis---but does not report extraction-evidence decoupling. MO-GRPO \cite{ichihara2025mogrpo} and RDPO \cite{bai2026rdpo} address reward hacking in multi-objective settings, while \citet{wang2026reward_hacking_survey} propose the Proxy Compression Hypothesis explaining reward hacking as objective compression.

A critical confound in RL for LLMs is quantization. QeRL \cite{qerl2025} shows standard quantization introduces deterministic noise harmful to RL exploration. \citet{quantization_rl_impact2025} find quantization-aware RL training actually harms learning, with post-training quantization performing better. \citet{shuttleworth2024lora_vs_fft} reveal LoRA and full fine-tuning produce structurally different weight matrices, with forgetting concentrated in ``intruder dimensions.'' Q-BLoRA \cite{seo2024qblora} identifies an imbalance between overly complex adapter I/O and insufficient trainability in quantized LLMs. CLoQ \cite{cloq2025} addresses quantization errors via calibrated LoRA initialization. These findings align with our observation that QLoRA amplifies the evidence-extraction decoupling from mild to catastrophic, acting not as the root cause but as a catastrophic amplifier of an inherent RL-for-IE pathology.
